## Type of change

- [ ] Content correction (broken link, outdated tool, factual error)

- [ ] Better lab for an existing day

## Checklist

- [ ] For a new or rewritten day: it follows [`curriculum/_template.md`](../curriculum/_template.md) and has a Practical section naming a tool and the artifact the learner builds, not just a reading list.
- [ ] For a change to `ai-agent-skills/`: the scope and ethics section is tightened or unchanged, never loosened.
- [ ] Every tool referenced is free, or a free alternative is listed next to it.
- [ ] This stays within authorized, defensive, lawful use, per [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
